nodes.description: Public payable transfer(address,uint) in EDXO that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)

Internal view condition(address,uint) enforcing _saleNum,_minSale,_maxSale and _onSaleNum limits
Public payable delegate(address,bytes) that performs an arbitrary delegatecall after owner check

Public owner-only init(uint,uint,uint) setting _minSale,_maxSale,_saleNum
